remarks: Panoramic views of Saddleback Mountain, rolling hills, and sparkling city lights provide a beautiful backdrop for this inviting three-bedroom residence in Aliso Viejo's Glenwood Park community. Positioned to capture the surrounding landscape, 10 Acorn offers a wonderful combination of comfortable living spaces, architectural character, and a private outdoor retreat. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light create an immediate sense of openness. The living room is the heart of the home, featuring a fireplace, dramatic ceiling heights, and an open connection to the dining area.
